itemDisplayName: Network Secured Agent Setup with capabilitySettings (Implicit Capability Hosts)
description: Network-secured Standard Agent setup with account network injection and project capabilitySettings selecting BYO stores. Capability hosts are implicit; all RBAC is assigned explicitly by enabled deployment modules or an authorized operator, never by the service.
summary: Network-injected agents with implicit capability hosts, BYO store settings, and explicit deployment-managed or operator-managed RBAC.
